summary: One bulletin (issue Sept 19-20, 2026), a Hudson Valley Vicariate West network bulletin that lists nine churches; only St. Patrick's, Ravena is this parish's church. Clear in the newest bulletin: Sat 4:30 PM and Sun 9:30 AM Masses, Mass on 2nd and 4th Tuesdays 9 AM, and Confession on 2nd and 4th Thursdays 5:30-6:30 PM. The other churches' times belong to their own parishes and are excluded. No open questions.
